Cluster Groups

1. What are Cluster Groups?
  • A cluster group is a logical subset of cluster nodes that you can target for compute, messaging, or service deployment;
  • Instead of running a compute task on all nodes, you can target specific nodes;
  • Represented by the ClusterGroup interface;
2. Predefined Cluster Groups
  • // All server nodes
ClusterGroup servers = ignite.cluster().forServers();

// All client nodes
ClusterGroup clients = ignite.cluster().forClients();

// Remote nodes (all except the local node)
ClusterGroup remotes = ignite.cluster().forRemotes();

// Local node only
ClusterGroup local = ignite.cluster().forLocal();

// Oldest node (useful for singleton-like patterns)
ClusterGroup oldest = ignite.cluster().forOldest();

// Random node
ClusterGroup random = ignite.cluster().forRandom();
3. Custom Cluster Groups
  • Filter by node attribute: 
    // Only nodes with specific attribute
ClusterGroup gpuNodes = ignite.cluster().forAttribute("has.gpu", "true");

// Set attribute on a node
IgniteConfiguration cfg = new IgniteConfiguration();
cfg.setUserAttributes(Collections.singletonMap("has.gpu", "true"));
  • Filter by predicate: 
    ClusterGroup highMem = ignite.cluster().forPredicate(node ->
    node.metrics().getHeapMemoryMaximum() > 4L * 1024 * 1024 * 1024
);
4. Using Cluster Groups with Compute
  • // Run compute only on server nodes
ignite.compute(ignite.cluster().forServers()).broadcast(() -> {
    System.out.println("Running on server: " + Ignition.localIgnite().name());
});

// Run compute on nodes with GPU
ClusterGroup gpuNodes = ignite.cluster().forAttribute("has.gpu", "true");
ignite.compute(gpuNodes).call(() -> {
    return runMLTraining();
});
5. Combining Cluster Groups
  • Cluster groups can be combined (intersection): 
    // Server nodes with GPU
ClusterGroup gpuServers = ignite.cluster()
    .forServers()
    .forAttribute("has.gpu", "true");
